name: What design trends are popular for small bathrooms that also add functionality?

mainEntity.name: What design trends are popular for small bathrooms that also add functionality?

acceptedAnswer.text: Popular design trends for small bathrooms often focus on maximizing both aesthetics and functionality. This includes minimalist designs with clean lines, floating vanities, and wall-mounted toilets for an open feel. Large format tiles can create a seamless look, while strategic lighting, including LED strips and sconces, enhances ambiance without consuming space. Incorporating smart storage solutions and reflective surfaces also remains a key trend.
acceptedAnswer.description: Popular small bathroom design trends include minimalist aesthetics, floating fixtures, large format tiles, strategic lighting, and smart storage for functionality.
